name: East Antarctica
fact: The larger eastern part of the continent, separated from West Antarctica by the Transantarctic Mountains.

name: West Antarctica
fact: Much of the bedrock beneath its ice lies below sea level. It includes the land facing the Amundsen and Bellingshausen seas.

name: Antarctic Peninsula
fact: This long, mountainous arm stretches north toward South America.

name: Transantarctic Mountains
fact: This mountain system forms the great divide between East and West Antarctica.

name: South Pole
fact: At 90° south, every direction away from this point is north. It lies inland on the Antarctic ice sheet.

name: Ross Ice Shelf
fact: A vast floating extension of the Antarctic ice sheet along the southern Ross Sea. An ice shelf is attached to land but floats on ocean water.

name: Filchner–Ronne Ice Shelf
fact: The adjoining Filchner and Ronne shelves occupy the southern end of the Weddell Sea.

name: Amery Ice Shelf
fact: A major floating ice shelf on the East Antarctic coast, fed by ice flowing from the interior.

name: Ross Sea
fact: This Southern Ocean sea lies north of the Ross Ice Shelf, between Victoria Land and Marie Byrd Land.

name: Weddell Sea
fact: East of the Antarctic Peninsula, this sea reaches south to the Filchner–Ronne Ice Shelf.

name: Amundsen Sea
fact: This sea borders West Antarctica, between the Ross and Bellingshausen sectors of the Southern Ocean.

name: Bellingshausen Sea
fact: This sea lies west of the Antarctic Peninsula, next to the Amundsen Sea.
